local LOOPED = { Idle = true, Run = true, Sleep = true }

local POS_SMOOTH = 12
local ROT_SMOOTH = 10
local SNAP_DISTANCE = 60
local MAX_PREDICT = 0.35
local FAR = 450
local FAR_EVERY = 6
local SETTLE_TIME = 0.2

local FADE = 0.2

local function ease(style, dir, a)
	if style == Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Constant then return 0 end
	if style == Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Linear then return a end
	if dir == Enum.PoseEasingDirection.In then return a * a * a end
	if dir == Enum.PoseEasingDirection.Out then return 1 - (1 - a) ^ 3 end
	return a < 0.5 and 4 * a * a * a or 1 - (-2 * a + 2) ^ 3 / 2
end

local function readClip(kfs, name, scale)
	local joints, length = {}, 0
	local frames = kfs:GetKeyframes()
	table.sort(frames, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	for _, kf in ipairs(frames) do
		length = math.max(length, kf.Time)
		for _, p in ipairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("Pose") and p.Weight > 0 then
				local j = joints[p.Name]
				if not j then
					j = { times = {}, cfs = {}, styles = {}, dirs = {} }
					joints[p.Name] = j
				end
				table.insert(j.times, kf.Time)
				table.insert(j.cfs, p.CFrame.Rotation + p.CFrame.Position * scale)
				table.insert(j.styles, p.EasingStyle)
				table.insert(j.dirs, p.EasingDirection)
			end
		end
	end
	return { joints = joints, length = length, loop = LOOPED[name] == true }
end

local function sampleJoint(j, t)
	local times = j.times
	local n = #times
	if n == 0 then return CFrame.identity end
	if t <= times[1] then return j.cfs[1] end
	if t >= times[n] then return j.cfs[n] end
	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while hi - lo > 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if times[mid] <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local span = times[hi] - times[lo]
	local a = span > 0 and (t - times[lo]) / span or 0
	return j.cfs[lo]:Lerp(j.cfs[hi], ease(j.styles[lo], j.dirs[lo], a))
end

local function setupAnimations(model)
	local ids = BossAnim.animations(model) or {}
	local embedded = BossAnim.embedded(model) or {}
	if next(ids) == nil and next(embedded) == nil then return nil end
	local motors = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part1 then motors[m.Part1.Name] = m end
	end
	local scale = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("AnimScale")) or 1
	local clips = {}
	for name, kfs in pairs(embedded) do clips[name] = readClip(kfs, name, scale) end
	local controller = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
	if not controller then
		controller = Instance.new("AnimationController")
		controller.Parent = model
	end
	local animator = controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = controller
	end
	local tracks = {}
	for name, id in pairs(ids) do
		local a = Instance.new("Animation")
		a.AnimationId = id
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Looped = LOOPED[name] == true
			track.Priority = (name == "Attack" or name == "Wake") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Action or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
			tracks[name] = track
		end
	end
	return { tracks = tracks, clips = clips, motors = motors, clock = 0 }
end

local function usableTrack(a, name)
	local t = a.tracks[name]
	if t and (t.Length > 0 or not a.clips[name]) then return t end
	return nil
end

local function has(a, name)
	return a.tracks[name] ~= nil or a.clips[name] ~= nil
end

local function resetJoints(a)
	for _, motor in pairs(a.motors) do motor.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function playAnimation(a, name, speed, restart)
	if not has(a, name) then name = "Idle" end
	if not has(a, name) then return end
	if a.name == name and not restart then
		if speed then
			a.speed = speed
			if a.track then a.track:AdjustSpeed(speed) end
		end
		return
	end
	local track = usableTrack(a, name)
	local wasTrack = a.track ~= nil
	if a.track then a.track:Stop(track and FADE or 0) a.track = nil end
	a.prevClip, a.prevTime = a.clip, a.time
	a.fade = a.clip and 0 or 1
	a.name, a.clip, a.time, a.speed = name, nil, 0, speed or 1
	if track then
		if a.prevClip then resetJoints(a) end
		track:Play(FADE)
		track:AdjustSpeed(a.speed)
		a.track = track
		a.prevClip = nil
	else
		a.clip = a.clips[name]
		a.dirty = true
		if wasTrack then a.prevClip = nil a.fade = 1 end
	end
end

local function clipTime(clip, t)
	if clip.length <= 0 then return 0 end
	if clip.loop then return t % clip.length end
	return math.min(t, clip.length)
end

local function stepEmbedded(a, dt)
	if not a.clip then return end
	a.time += dt * (a.speed or 1)
	if a.prevClip then a.prevTime += dt end
	a.fade = math.min(1, (a.fade or 1) + dt / FADE)
	local t = clipTime(a.clip, a.time)
	local pt = a.prevClip and clipTime(a.prevClip, a.prevTime)
	local blending = a.prevClip ~= nil and a.fade < 1
	for name, motor in pairs(a.motors) do
		local j = a.clip.joints[name]
		local pj = blending and a.prevClip.joints[name]
		if j or pj or a.dirty then
			local cf = j and sampleJoint(j, t) or CFrame.identity
			if pj then cf = sampleJoint(pj, pt):Lerp(cf, a.fade) end
			motor.Transform = cf
		end
	end
	a.dirty = blending or nil
	if a.fade >= 1 then a.prevClip = nil end
end

local live = {}
local byIndex = {}
local held = {}

local function adopt(model)
	if live[model] then return end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 200 do
			if model:GetAttribute("BossCF") then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		local cf = model:GetAttribute("BossCF")
		if not model.Parent or live[model] or not cf then return end
		local anim = setupAnimations(model)
		if not anim then
			warn(("[Boss] %s has no animations - add Idle/Run/Attack/Sleep/Wake animation ids to its Boss model"):format(model.Name))
		else
			task.delay(10, function()
				for name, t in pairs(anim.tracks) do
					if t.Length <= 0 then
						warn(("[Boss] %s: animation %s did not load - publish it for this game or set its id to 0 to use the saved one"):format(model.Name, name))
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		live[model] = {
			anim = anim,
			pos = cf.Position,
			rot = cf - cf.Position,
			shown = cf,
			phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
			frame = math.random(0, FAR_EVERY - 1),
		}
		local index = model:GetAttribute("BossIndex")
		if index then byIndex[index] = model end
	end)
end

for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do adopt(m) end

folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(m) live[m] = nil end)

local function trackEgg(egg)
	if not egg:IsA("Model") then return end
	local cf, size = egg:GetBoundingBox()
	settling[egg] = nil
	held[egg] = { bottom = egg:GetPivot().Position.Y - (cf.Position.Y - size.Y / 2) }
end
for _, egg in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("BossHeldEgg")) do trackEgg(egg) end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("BossHeldEgg"):Connect(trackEgg)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("BossHeldEgg"):Connect(function(egg)
	if held[egg] and egg.Parent then
		settling[egg] = { from = egg:GetPivot(), t = 0, wait = 0 }
	end
	held[egg] = nil
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local eye = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
	local attackTime = folder:GetAttribute("AttackTime") or 0.65
	local posBlend = 1 - math.exp(-dt * POS_SMOOTH)
	local rotBlend = 1 - math.exp(-dt * ROT_SMOOTH)

	for model, e in pairs(live) do
		if not model.Parent then
			live[model] = nil
			continue
		end
		local stamp = model:GetAttribute("BossStamp") or 0
		if stamp >= (e.stamp or 0) then
			e.stamp = stamp
			e.cf = model:GetAttribute("BossCF") or e.cf
			e.vel = model:GetAttribute("BossVel") or Vector3.zero
		end
		local cf, vel = e.cf, e.vel
		if not cf then continue end
		local age = now - (e.stamp or now)
		local state = model:GetAttribute("BossState") or "sleep"
		local since = now - (model:GetAttribute("BossStateAt") or now)
		local wakeTime = folder:GetAttribute("WakeTime") or 1.35

		local goal = cf.Position + vel * math.clamp(age, 0, MAX_PREDICT)
		local goalRot = cf - cf.Position
		if (goal - e.pos).Magnitude > SNAP_DISTANCE then
			e.pos, e.rot = goal, goalRot
		else
			if age < MAX_PREDICT then e.pos += vel * dt end
			e.pos = e.pos:Lerp(goal, posBlend)
			e.rot = e.rot:Lerp(goalRot, rotBlend)
		end
		e.shown = CFrame.new(e.pos) * e.rot

		local offset = CFrame.identity
		if state == "sleep" then
			e.phase += dt
			offset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(e.phase * 0.22) * 0.10, 0)
		elseif state == "waking" then
			local k = math.clamp(since / wakeTime, 0, 1)
			offset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(since * 26) * (1 - k) * 0.30, 0)
		end

		local far = eye ~= nil and (e.pos - eye).Magnitude > FAR
		e.frame += 1
		if not far or e.frame % FAR_EVERY == 0 then
			local render = e.shown * offset
			e.posed = render
			model:PivotTo(render)
		end

		local a = e.anim
		if a then
			local flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
			if state == "sleep" then
				playAnimation(a, "Sleep", 1)
			elseif state == "waking" then
				playAnimation(a, "Wake", 1)
			elseif state == "attack" then
				local at = model:GetAttribute("BossStateAt")
				if a.attackAt ~= at then
					a.attackAt = at
					local track, clip = usableTrack(a, "Attack"), a.clips.Attack
					local len = track and track.Length or clip and clip.length or 0
					playAnimation(a, "Attack", len > 0 and len / math.max(attackTime, 0.2) or 1, true)
				end
			elseif flat > 1 then
				playAnimation(a, "Run", math.clamp(flat / 45, 0.6, 2))
			else
				playAnimation(a, "Idle", 1)
			end
			if not far or e.frame % FAR_EVERY == 0 then
				a.pending = (a.pending or 0) + dt
				stepEmbedded(a, a.pending)
				a.pending = 0
			else
				a.pending = (a.pending or 0) + dt
			end
		end
	end

	for eggModel, h in pairs(held) do
		if not eggModel.Parent then
			held[eggModel] = nil
			continue
		end
		local boss = byIndex[eggModel:GetAttribute("HeldBy")]
		local e = boss and live[boss]
		if e then
			local H = boss:GetAttribute("BossH") or 10
			local base = e.posed or e.shown
			local p = base.Position + base.LookVector * (H * 0.42)
			eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p.X, H * 0.30 + h.bottom, p.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, eggModel:GetAttribute("HeldYaw") or 0, 0))
		end
	end

	for eggModel, s in pairs(settling) do
		local current = eggModel.Parent and eggModel:GetPivot()
		local loose = eggModel.PrimaryPart and not eggModel.PrimaryPart.Anchored
		if current and not s.goal then
			s.wait += dt
			if (current.Position - s.from.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
				s.goal = current
			end
		end
		if not current or loose or (not s.goal and s.wait > 0.5) then
			settling[eggModel] = nil
		elseif s.goal then
			s.t += dt
			local u = math.min(s.t / SETTLE_TIME, 1)
			eggModel:PivotTo(s.from:Lerp(s.goal, u * u * (3 - 2 * u)))
			if u >= 1 then
				settling[eggModel] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

local BLEND_SPEED = 10
local GRIP_GAP = 0.05
local GRIP_BACK = 0.35
local GRIP_DOWN = 0.15
local POLE = Vector3.new(0.7, -1, 0.8)
local DOWN = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
local FORWARD = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

local blend = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastTarget = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function rotBetween(a, b)
	local dot = math.clamp(a:Dot(b), -1, 1)
	local axis = a:Cross(b)
	if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 then
		return dot > 0 and CFrame.identity or CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.xAxis, math.pi)
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot))
end

local function basis(up, hint, fallback)
	local look = hint - up * hint:Dot(up)
	if look.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		look = fallback - up * fallback:Dot(up)
	end
	look = look.Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, look:Cross(up), up, -look)
end

local function isJoint(j)
	return j ~= nil and (j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint"))
end

local function frames(j)
	if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.C0, j.C1 end
	local a0, a1 = j.Attachment0, j.Attachment1
	return a0 and a0.CFrame or CFrame.identity, a1 and a1.CFrame or CFrame.identity
end

local function armOf(char, side)
	local upper = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "UpperArm")
	local lower = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "LowerArm")
	local hand = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "Hand")
	local sh = upper and upper:FindFirstChild(side .. "Shoulder")
	local el = lower and lower:FindFirstChild(side .. "Elbow")
	local wr = hand and hand:FindFirstChild(side .. "Wrist")
	if isJoint(sh) and isJoint(el) and isJoint(wr) then
		return { sh = sh, el = el, wr = wr, hand = hand, sign = (side == "Right") and 1 or -1 }
	end
	return nil
end

local function rigOf(char)
	local rig = rigs[char]
	if rig and rig.torso.Parent == char and rig.arms[1].sh.Parent and rig.arms[2].sh.Parent then
		return rig
	end
	local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local right, left = armOf(char, "Right"), armOf(char, "Left")
	if not (torso and right and left) then
		rigs[char] = nil
		return nil
	end
	rig = { torso = torso, arms = { right, left } }
	rigs[char] = rig
	return rig
end

local function solve(arm, target, w)
	local sh, el, wr = arm.sh, arm.el, arm.wr
	local s0, s1 = frames(sh)
	local e0, e1 = frames(el)
	local w0, w1 = frames(wr)
	local S = s0.Position
	local v1 = e0.Position - s1.Position
	local v2 = w0.Position - e1.Position
	local L1 = v1.Magnitude
	local L2 = v2.Magnitude + w1.Position.Magnitude
	if L1 < 1e-3 or L2 < 1e-3 then return end

	local toT = target - S
	local dist = toT.Magnitude
	local dir = dist > 1e-4 and toT / dist or DOWN
	local d = math.clamp(dist, math.abs(L1 - L2) + 0.02, L1 + L2 - 0.02)
	local pole = Vector3.new(POLE.X * arm.sign, POLE.Y, POLE.Z)
	local perp = pole - dir * pole:Dot(dir)
	perp = perp.Magnitude > 1e-4 and perp.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	local cosA = math.clamp((L1 * L1 + d * d - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * d), -1, 1)
	local sinA = math.sqrt(1 - cosA * cosA)
	local E = S + dir * (cosA * L1) + perp * (sinA * L1)
	local T = S + dir * d

	local upperRot = basis((S - E).Unit, T - E, FORWARD) * rotBetween(DOWN, v1.Unit):Inverse()
	local upperCF = CFrame.new(S - upperRot * s1.Position) * upperRot
	sh.Transform = sh.Transform:Lerp(s0:Inverse() * upperCF * s1, w)

	local elbow = upperCF * e0.Position
	local lowerUp = elbow - T
	lowerUp = lowerUp.Magnitude > 1e-4 and lowerUp.Unit or -DOWN
	local lowerRot = basis(lowerUp, lowerUp:Cross(upperCF.RightVector), upperCF.LookVector)
		* rotBetween(DOWN, v2.Unit):Inverse()
	local lowerCF = CFrame.new(elbow - lowerRot * e1.Position) * lowerRot
	el.Transform = el.Transform:Lerp(e0:Inverse() * upperCF:Inverse() * lowerCF * e1, w)
	wr.Transform = wr.Transform:Lerp(CFrame.identity, w)
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = p.Character
		if char then
			local center = p:GetAttribute("CarryCenter")
			local size = p:GetAttribute("CarrySize")
			local on = p:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == true
				and typeof(center) == "Vector3" and typeof(size) == "Vector3"
			if on then lastTarget[char] = { center, size } end

			local w = math.clamp((blend[char] or 0) + (on and dt or -dt) * BLEND_SPEED, 0, 1)
			blend[char] = w > 0 and w or nil

			local target = lastTarget[char]
			if w > 0 and target then
				local rig = rigOf(char)
				if rig then
					local c, half = target[1], target[2] / 2
					local k = w * w * (3 - 2 * w)
					for _, arm in ipairs(rig.arms) do
						local grip = c + Vector3.new(
							arm.sign * (half.X * 0.94 + GRIP_GAP + arm.hand.Size.X / 2),
							-half.Y * GRIP_DOWN,
							half.Z * GRIP_BACK)
						solve(arm, grip, k)
					end
				end
			elseif not on then
				lastTarget[char] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function fitSections()
	for _, p in ipairs(sections) do
		local lowest = 0
		for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local h = c.Size.Y.Offset
				if h == 0 then h = c.AbsoluteSize.Y end
				lowest = math.max(lowest, c.Position.Y.Offset + h)
			end
		end
		p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, math.max(lowest + PAGE_PAD * 2, 40))
	end
end

local function shortNum(n)
	n = tonumber(n) or 0
	local units = { { 1e15, "Qa" }, { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" } }
	for _, u in ipairs(units) do
		if math.abs(n) >= u[1] then
			local s = ("%.2f"):format(n / u[1]):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
			return s .. u[2]
		end
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(n))
end

local AMOUNT_SUFFIX = { K = 1e3, M = 1e6, B = 1e9, T = 1e12, QA = 1e15 }
local function parseAmount(text)
	local s = tostring(text or ""):gsub("[%s,%$]", ""):upper()
	local digits, suffix = s:match("^([%d%.]+)(%a*)$")
	local n = tonumber(digits)
	if not n then return nil end
	if suffix ~= "" then
		local k = AMOUNT_SUFFIX[suffix]
		if not k then return nil end
		n *= k
	end
	return math.floor(n)
end

local function refreshBoostRows()
	local now = os.time()
	for kind, row in pairs(boostRows) do
		local e = boostLive[kind]
		local rowNow = now
		if row.def.live then
			e = row.def.live()
			rowNow = e.now
		end
		local active = false
		if type(e) == "table" and (e.active or (tonumber(e.mult) or 1) > 1) then
			local ends = tonumber(e.endsAt) or 0
			if ends == 0 or ends > rowNow then
				active = true
				local mult = tonumber(e.mult) or 1
				if ends > 0 and row.def.noValue then
					local left = math.ceil(ends - rowNow)
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE - %d:%02d left"):format(left // 60, left % 60)
				elseif ends > 0 then
					local left = math.ceil(ends - rowNow)
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE x%g - %d:%02d left"):format(mult, left // 60, left % 60)
				else
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE x%g - no limit"):format(mult)
				end
			end
		end
		if not active then row.status.Text = "off" end
		if row.painted ~= active then
			row.painted = active
			UIKit.repaint(row.start, active and K.inProgress or K.ready)
			local label = row.start:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
			if label then label.Text = active and "UPDATE" or "START" end
		end
	end
end

local function shown(o)
	local a = o
	while a and a ~= pg do
		if a:IsA("GuiObject") and not a.Visible then return false end
		if a:IsA("LayerCollector") and not a.Enabled then return false end
		a = a.Parent
	end
	return a == pg
end

local function usable(o)
	return o:IsA("GuiButton") and o.Active and o.Selectable
		and o.AbsoluteSize.X > 4 and o.AbsoluteSize.Y > 4 and shown(o)
end

local function menuOpen()
	local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PanelBlur")
	if blur and blur.Enabled then return true end
	for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
		if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen:GetAttribute("Open") == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function panel()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize.X * camera.ViewportSize.Y or 1
	local pick, order, size = nil, nil, nil
	for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
		if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
			local top, area = nil, 0
			for _, d in screen:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("GuiObject") and not SKIP[d.Name] and d.Visible then
					local a = d.AbsoluteSize.X * d.AbsoluteSize.Y
					if a > area and shown(d) then
						for _, c in d:GetDescendants() do
							if usable(c) then top, area = d, a break end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if top and (screen:GetAttribute("Open") == true or area >= view * 0.35) then
				if not pick or screen.DisplayOrder > order or (screen.DisplayOrder == order and area > size) then
					pick, order, size = top, screen.DisplayOrder, area
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pick
end

local function choose(root)
	for _, name in PREFERRED do
		for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
			if d.Name == name and usable(d) then return d end
		end
	end
	local pick, score = nil, math.huge
	for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
		if usable(d) and d.Name ~= "Close" then
			local v = d.AbsolutePosition.Y * 4 + d.AbsolutePosition.X
			if v < score then pick, score = d, v end
		end
	end
	if pick then return pick end
	local close = root:FindFirstChild("Close", true)
	return close and usable(close) and close or nil
end

local function release()
	if not group then return end
	if Gui.SelectedObject and Gui.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(group) then Gui.SelectedObject = nil end
	group.SelectionGroup = false
	group = nil
end

local function hudEntry()

		for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
			if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
				for _, d in screen:GetDescendants() do
					if d.Name == name and usable(d) then return d end

function refreshBoost()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local shown = 0

	for _, def in ipairs(BOOST) do
		local card = boostCards[def.kind]
		local entry = boostState[def.kind]

		local live = entry ~= nil and entry.mult > 1
			and (entry.endsAt == 0 or entry.endsAt > now)
			and not lobbyHidden

		if live then
			shown += 1
			card.mult.Text = ("x%g"):format(entry.mult)
			if entry.endsAt > 0 then
				local left = entry.endsAt - now
				card.clock.Text = boostLeft(left)
				card.clock.TextColor3 = (left <= 30) and ENDING_COLOUR or CLOCK_COLOUR
			else
				card.clock.Text = ""
			end

			if not card.holder.Visible then
				card.holder.Visible = true
				card.scale.Scale = 0.6
				TweenService:Create(card.scale,
					TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Scale = 1 }):Play()
			end
		else
			card.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end

	boostRow.Visible = shown > 0
	if shown == 0 then return end

	local rightInset = CORNER_MARGIN
	local bottomInset = CORNER_MARGIN + CORNER_BASE + 10
	boostRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightInset, 1, -bottomInset)

	local natural = shown * SLOT_W + (shown - 1) * SLOT_GAP
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local fit = 1
	if cam then
		fit = cam.ViewportSize.X * 0.86 / natural

		local emotes = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("EmoteHud")
		local face = emotes and emotes:FindFirstChild("EmoteButton")
		if face and face.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
			local canvas = cam.ViewportSize.Y - game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y
			local ceiling = face.AbsolutePosition.Y + face.AbsoluteSize.Y + 14
			fit = math.min(fit, (canvas - bottomInset - ceiling - 8) / CARD_H)
		end
	end
	boostScale.Scale = math.clamp(fit, 0.5, 1)
end

local function applyToSound(sound)
	if baseVolume[sound] == nil then baseVolume[sound] = sound.Volume end
	sound.Volume = baseVolume[sound] * scaleFor(sound)
end

local function applyAll()
	for sound in pairs(baseVolume) do
		if sound.Parent then applyToSound(sound) end
	end
end

local function hook(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Sound") then
		applyToSound(inst)
	end
end

PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)

local function row(order, name)

		parent = root, name = "Row_" .. name:gsub("%s", ""), tone = K.row,
		radius = 14, stud = 13,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, ROW_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, BAR_H + GAP_HEADER + (order - 1) * (ROW_H + ROW_GAP)),

	})

		parent = w, name = "Label",
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_W, ROW_H - 20), position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 10),
		text = name, align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, textSize = 21,
		truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, zindex = 16,
	})
	return w
end

local function toggle(key, name, order, words)
	local onWord, offWord = words and words[1] or "ON", words and words[2] or "OFF"
	local w = row(order, name)
	local b = UIKit.block({
		parent = w, name = "Toggle", tone = K.ready, radius = 11, clickable = true, stud = 11,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(TOGGLE_W, BTN_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_X + CTRL_W - TOGGLE_W, math.floor((ROW_H - BTN_H) / 2)),
		zindex = 16,
	})
	local label = UIKit.boldLabel({
		parent = b, name = "Label", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		text = onWord, textSize = 19, zindex = 20,
	})
	UIKit.reactToCursor(b)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		remote:FireServer("set", key, not S[key])
	end)
	controls[key] = function(v)
		label.Text = v and onWord or offWord
		UIKit.repaint(b, v and K.ready or K.close)
	end
end

local function volume(order)
	local w = row(order, "VOLUME")
	local SIDE = BTN_H
	local y = math.floor((ROW_H - BTN_H) / 2)
	local function step(name, sign, x, tone, delta)
		local b = UIKit.block({
			parent = w, name = name, tone = tone, radius = 11, clickable = true, stud = 11,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIDE, SIDE), position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), zindex = 16,
		})

		local LEN, THICK, EDGE = 22, 6, 2
		local function bar(w2, h2, z, colour, pad)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.Name = "Sign"
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w2 + pad * 2, h2 + pad * 2)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.ZIndex = z
			f.Active = false
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(THICK / 2) + pad)
			c.Parent = f
			f.Parent = b
		end
		bar(LEN, THICK, 19, K.outline, EDGE)
		bar(LEN, THICK, 20, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
		if sign == "+" then
			bar(THICK, LEN, 19, K.outline, EDGE)
			bar(THICK, LEN, 20, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
		end
		UIKit.reactToCursor(b)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			remote:FireServer("set", "Volume", math.clamp(S.Volume + delta, 0, 1))
		end)
	end
	step("Minus", "-", CTRL_X + CTRL_W - 2 * SIDE - 16, K.close, -0.1)
	step("Plus", "+", CTRL_X + CTRL_W - SIDE, K.ready, 0.1)

	local value = UIKit.darkLabel({
		parent = w, name = "Value",
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_W - 2 * SIDE - 30, BTN_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_X, y),
		text = "70%", align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, textSize = 21, zindex = 16,
	})
	controls.Volume = function(v)
		value.Text = ("%d%%"):format(math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5))
	end
end

local HIDEABLE = { "BillboardGui", "SurfaceGui", "ParticleEmitter", "Beam", "Trail", "Highlight", "Light" }
local petFolder

local function petHidden(model)
	local owner = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId"))
	if owner == LocalPlayer.UserId then return S.HideOwnPets == true end
	return S.HideOtherPets == true
end

local function hidePart(d, hide)
	if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then
		d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hide and 1 or 0
		return
	end
	for _, class in ipairs(HIDEABLE) do
		if d:IsA(class) then
			local was = d:GetAttribute("PetHideWas")
			if hide then
				if was == nil then d:SetAttribute("PetHideWas", d.Enabled) end
				d.Enabled = false
			elseif was ~= nil then
				d.Enabled = was
				d:SetAttribute("PetHideWas", nil)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

local function applyPet(model, force)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	local hide = petHidden(model)
	if not force and (model:GetAttribute("PetHidden") == true) == hide then return end
	model:SetAttribute("PetHidden", hide)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do hidePart(d, hide) end
end

local function applyPets()
	if not petFolder then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(petFolder:GetChildren()) do applyPet(m) end
end

local function watchPet(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnerUserId"):Connect(function() applyPet(model) end)
	model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if model:GetAttribute("PetHidden") == true then hidePart(d, true) end
	end)
	applyPet(model, true)
end

	applyAll()

end)
